statement: Luminous Monogamy update brings insane buffs and changes some weekly information that he will add to weeklies.
Pick artifact find chance merit is very good this week given new high-requirement artifact tiers; helps a lot.
Merit likely sweeps since it usually wins anyway; great time to push the new bonuses.
Stamp production would have been nice to bring stamp prices within range for no-stamp-left-behind efficiency.
Masses chose brain coral the worst merit in the game; it makes merit week a completely dead week.
Brain coral only gives extra grind time bubble levels; in world 7 maybe 20 minutes of gains maximum versus months of progress from other merits.
Extremely important week on exotic market: better exotic and plump database both available; high ST and prime doubler targets.
Send both better exotic and plump database into the tens of thousands range and keep pushing.
New organic labels from Luminous Monogamy make plump database one of few ways to buff land rank database which is already strong.
Better exotic gives level per level for exotic market.
If you only have one label give priority to better exotic over plump database.
Genealogy one and two better night two and growth speed are all excellent for overall farming progression.
Studious and grapevine are not bad; studious weaker than exotic spelunking brethren but still solid.
Grapevine is strong for villager EXP but not top tier; consider an organic label if pushing hole or focused on it.
Alpha Omega $10 pack is cheaper and worthwhile: 2x Lumi gains and +3 missions and 5 research points and 1.25x damage; easy S tier.
Cosmic balls are fairly frequent but Omega balls hard to farm so 10 is great; mission costs scale dramatically and research points are hard to get.
Imperial power pack gives 3x Lumi gains multiplying previous 2x for 6x; doublers alone make it worth it for research mini games.
Pack outfit is the biggest attire power creep since Corsair outfit and warps the game around it; high S plus tier.
Pack of magnificence: 3x Lumi gain brings total to 18x; palette black stars letters boost exalt and prisma about 50%; showcase podiums up to four.
Lucky lad probably best contender for podiums; Magni pet is niche but ridiculously powerful and the plus pet version pushes further.
Artifact chance at 5x base might be a necessity for new tier of artifacts.
Pack includes a research shape (moon shape) which otherwise only comes from events; also gems.
Pack earns its $35 price tag with an unreal amount of buffs; S plus tier.
Don't break the bank; Halloween event Friday presumably with new pets and bundles and an exclusive pet that has historically been game-changing.
Weekly boss is Fat Egg Pong; codes on screen.
Miscellaneous run nets five trophies and 105% class EXP and zero bonus damage; not bad for trophies.
Next week is a nine trophy week.
Extra weekly boss damage comes from gym mush kill digits and alchemy level and class level.
One of the worst lab weeks; chips are whatever; conductor nano chip is okay for lab experience.
Emerald navette jewel is surprisingly good due to skill speed which works with mechanics like spelunking late game; eventually want all jewels.
Emerald navette is relatively easy to get requiring yellow snowflakes and wild boar meal and crystal cavern spice.
New patch Friday with presumably Halloween event; get wallets ready for crazy new exclusive pet.
Pet of mages is still bugged.
